title: Typed LLM extraction consumed by a gate

inputs.content:
id,note
e1,Order A17 contains 3 units and is urgent.
e2,Order B04 contains 1 unit and is not urgent.
e3,Order C99 contains 12 units and is urgent.

turns: Using the sonnet LLM profile, extract order_code as string, units as integer and urgent as boolean from each note in order_notes.csv using a declared structured-output schema. Preserve id. Use a gate that consumes the typed urgent boolean to route true to urgent.jsonl and false to normal.jsonl. Use field_mapper to retain exactly id,order_code,units,urgent. Do not replace LLM extraction with regex or hand-coded mappings. Validate and preview, and show any required interpretation reviews.

review_policy.constraints: Inspect each presented draft against every explicit requirement in turns. Accept only matching meanings; never approve a changed output, dropped row, weaker type or unrelated requirement. Source data must match supplied input bytes; any model choice must retain the approved sonnet profile.
